title: Environment Inventory and Variable Layout
objective: Separate environments while sharing intentional group configuration.

sourceAlignment.title: Ansible for DevOps, 2nd Edition
sourceAlignment.author: Jeff Geerling
sourceAlignment.note: Original Code Forge companion material; no book prose is reproduced.

paragraphs: Development, staging, and production should use distinct inventory sources to make targeting explicit. Group hierarchy represents shared roles without encoding procedure.
group_vars applies shared values and host_vars handles true exceptions. Inventory variables are not a safe plaintext secret store, and duplicated values signal a missing group.
explanation.rule: Operational rule: Separate environments while sharing intentional group configuration.

examples.title: Working design artifact
examples.code:
layout:
  environments: separate_inventory_sources
  shared_values: group_vars
  exceptions: host_vars
  plaintext_secrets: forbidden
examples.note: Use this as a reasoning model before applying changes to the disposable lab.
